'''Bombarde''' was an unusual game of chance.

==Characteristics==
The game was played onboard the ''[[Cal Ambre]]'' and utilized its [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannon]]. The nearby moon [[Rove]] was electronically covered with a gridwork pattern. Asteroids were shot from the mass-driver at random and passengers would bet on where on the grid the asteroids would land.
